versions.changelog:
- Clarified that Google Hotels review text is not available through StayingAPI; /v1/reviews returns an error for Google.
- Updated guidance to use aggregate ratings from /v1/search for Google Hotels, or review texts from Booking.com, Airbnb, or Vrbo instead.
- Added a platform × endpoint support matrix, highlighting the lack of Google Hotels review support.
- Removed outdated files and revised documentation for accuracy and clearer instructions.
- Updated tags and metadata to reflect Google Hotels review limitations and proper alternatives.

- Initial release of the google-hotels-reviews skill.
- Retrieve normalized Google Hotels reviews for any listing, preserving native rating scales.
- Supports paginated review fetching with filtering by language and listing ID or URL.
- Requires a StayingAPI key (free sandbox available) for all requests.
- No additional dependencies; internet access to api.stayingapi.com required.
- Cross-platform schema compatible with other hotel OTAs through StayingAPI.
